evaluations.claim: The en&el pair collapses to near-baseline levels by layer 10 and remains stagnant until a late resurgence to 0.18 at layer 22.
evaluations.reality: The en&el pair actually declines to approximately 0.05 by layer 10 but does not remain stagnant; it fluctuates slightly and rises to 0.30 at layer 22, not 0.18.

evaluations.claim: The en&bn pair consistently surpasses the en&el pair after layer 8.
evaluations.reality: The en&bn pair does not consistently surpass the en&el pair after layer 8; they are closely matched, with the en&el pair occasionally exceeding the en&bn pair (e.g., around layer 12).
evaluations.reason: en&bn and en&el closely matched after layer 8.

evaluations.claim: The en&es pair maintains a similarity of roughly 0.12 between layers 10 and 16.
evaluations.reality: The en&es pair maintains a similarity closer to 0.15-0.17 between layers 10 and 16, not 0.12.
